ability.name: Stellar Slash
ability.desc:
Heal @ModifiedHeal@ (%i:scaleAP%), then deal @ModifiedDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleArmor%) physical damage to the current target.

N.O.V.A. Strike: Cleave the battlefield, briefly knocking up all enemies and dealing @ModifiedNovaDamage@ (%i:scaleAD%%i:scaleArmor%) physical damage.

sampleTrait.name: Anima
sampleTrait.desc:
After losing a player combat, gain @TechPerCombat@ Tech, plus additional Tech equal to @TechPerLoss@ times the length of your loss streak. Additionally, gain @TechPerKill@ Tech per Anima takedown.

Each time Animas get @TechBreakpoint@ Tech, they prototype new Anima Weapons. You can take them, or save your Tech to get more powerful weapons next time.

(@MinUnits@) Start Researching!
(@MinUnits@) After each player combat, gain loot!

Gain @PairsPartnerWinMultiplier*100@% Tech from losing if your partner wins a combat in Double Up.
